::: {.page-intro}
## Overview

Before the MGEM program, I worked on a range of hands-on GIS and remote sensing projects that strengthened my practical skills in land-cover classification, environmental mapping, forest analysis, hazard assessment, UAV applications, and geospatial data visualization.

These projects span different platforms and workflows, including **QGIS**, **ArcGIS Pro**, **Google Earth Engine**, **R**, and **Python**, and show the progression of my technical experience across applied environmental and spatial problems.
:::
